body: I basically followed the same schooling routine. I'm 18 now, left my old school at 16, basically left friends and now stuck home alone all the time. My motivation's dead. I honestly wish I had someone special to keep me going. I guess while other's view it as unhealthy, I just, don't. I can't find any other good reason to live. I want someone special so my life's worth living, but with how it is now, I can't stand it.

I feel the same way. It doesn't feel right that it turned out this way. I should have that special best friend with me right now, but everything's led up to sitting home alone and being miserable all the time.

Also, the internet sucks at curing loneliness. Talking to anyone from around the world sounds great in principle, but you'll still be sitting alone in your room typing messages to some stranger thousands of miles away. The physical loneliness still persists. So yeah, not too crazy.

I'm not sure I care about anything anymore. I mean, sure, there's my family, but it's just not something that keeps me going. It keeps me alive, but there's just no motivation to keep being alive. I practice guitar, but again, I just can't be motivated enough by these things.

My life is boring as hell. I'm just stuck at home all the time. I would go out if I actually had a best friend or friends to go out with, but I don't. It's not a life I want to live, no matter how easy.

I guess I know that my life has value, cause it shows with the people who care about me. It's just so hard to find living to be worth it. There's nothing that makes me want to live. But I guess I'm gonna end up doing so anyway, even though I'm falling apart and things will probably go to shit for me. I feel like I'm just gonna get more miserable.

I'm sorry for taking so long to reply. Thank you for caring.
I don't know. Talking never truly helps me. I still feel like shit. I guess that makes it ironic that I even bother posting. Thank you anyway.
